name: Dinas Mawddwy Foodbank
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank serving Dinas Mawddwy
description: Nearest foodbank at Machynlleth. Part of The Trussell Trust network. Open Wed 10am-1pm. Referral required via local agencies including Dinas Mawddwy Post Office.

name: Powys County Council Allotments
short_description: Powys Council allotment sites in Dinas Mawddwy area
description: Small plots available in the village. From £20/year. Contact Dinas Mawddwy Village Hall for availability.

name: Dinas Mawddwy Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run garden behind the village hall. Grows hardy varieties suited to mountain climate. Surplus shared with elderly residents.
